summary: Computes the scene extent by walking the collision geometry node list once: it reads the node count via AudioNetworkNodeCount(dword_8AFE88), then for each active node (LinkedListFlagBitExtraction non-zero and the node's byte at offset 60 with bit 0x10 clear) calls BoundingBoxComputation to get a bounding box and folds its six outputs into running min (v6,v7,v8, initialized to +FLT_MAX) and max (v9,v10,v11, initialized to -FLT_MAX) accumulators. If no node produces a non-degenerate box (maxX<=minX or maxZ<=minZ on the two stored axes), it returns an error path that emits the CouldNotGetExt debug log. Otherwise it stores the normalized extents on `this`: this[585]=min0, this[587]=min2, this[586]=8.0/(max0-min0), this[588]=8.0/(max2-min2). Existing analysis labels the two stored axes X and Z (scene min extent / scale for rendering).

operations.description: Initialize the three minimum accumulators v6, v7, v8 to 3.4028235e38 (FLT_MAX).
Initialize the three maximum accumulators v9, v10, v11 to -3.4028235e38 (-FLT_MAX).
v1 = AudioNetworkNodeCount(dword_8AFE88) to obtain the number of nodes in the collision geometry list.
Iterate v2 from 0 while v2 < v1; if v1 <= 0 the loop body is skipped entirely (jump to the post-loop degenerate-bounds check).
v3 = LinkedListNodeFinder(v2) to fetch the node at index v2.
Process the node only when LinkedListFlagBitExtraction(v3) is non-zero and the node's byte at offset 60 does not have bit 0x10 set; otherwise skip to the next index.
BoundingBoxComputation(&v15) computes the node's bounding box into the stack output buffer; its six float outputs v12..v17 are subsequently consumed by the min/max fold.
Fold first three bounding-box outputs into the minima: if v6 > v12 then v6 = v12; if v7 > v13 then v7 = v13; if v8 > v14 then v8 = v14.
Fold remaining three bounding-box outputs into the maxima: if v9 < v15 then v9 = v15; if v10 < v16 then v10 = v16; if v11 < v17 then v11 = v17.
Increment v2 and repeat the node iteration while v2 < v1.
After the loop, if v9 <= v6 || v10 <= v7 || v11 <= v8 the extent is degenerate (no valid bounding range); this triggers the error path. The same guard is reached when the node list was empty.
On the error path, result = StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_23, 321) to obtain the source-path debug string.
If the split result is non-null, return DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aCouldNotGetExt) to emit the 'could not get extent' error log.
On success, this[585] (offset 0x924) = v6, the stored minimum of the first tracked axis (labeled scene min X in existing analysis).
On success, this[587] (offset 0x92C) = v8, the stored minimum of the third tracked axis (labeled scene min Z in existing analysis).
On success, this[586] (offset 0x928) = 8.0 / (v9 - v6), the normalized X scale from the first axis range.
On success, this[588] (offset 0x930) = 8.0 / (v11 - v8), the normalized Z scale from the third axis range.
Return `this` on success; on the degenerate/empty path return the StringSplitLoop result, or DebugLogWrite's return value when the split succeeded.
